issues.title: Verify existing source runtime contracts with native CI
issues.body:
Add 6 synthetic regression cases for the existing JavaScript runtime and a separately named product-runtime workflow. The quality guide links native CI runs and explains the measured scope.

Validation: all 6 tests passed locally on Node 24.11.0, including native V8 coverage. Existing runtime files, public exports, package manifest, lockfile, license, and repository-policy workflow are byte-for-byte unchanged. No package installation or release is performed by the new workflow.

Resolved by hathq/ihat-store-core#4: the source adapter and all six native regression cases are maintained under packages/ihat-store-source and pass the owner CI. This legacy repository remains archived.

issues.title: Clarify usage, outcomes and implementation scope
issues.body:
Readers can see what the repository enables, how to start, and which behavior is implemented. The README and usage guide retain declared dependency prerequisites and distinguish source verification from product or deployment acceptance.

Validation: local Markdown/link checks, source disclosure scan, unchanged license/notice, and existing OSS policy checks where defined. No package publication or deployment is requested.

limits: Issue snapshots preserve observed API records, not unavailable external discussions.
This is preservation evidence, not deletion approval or registry availability.
